commenti.body: It’s been a long time since I’ve watched the whole movie but the fact that it has two of my favorite all time actors being directed by one of my all time favorite directors keeps it haunting in my mind. I’ve rewatched the beginning twenty minutes so many times over the years. Antonioni is such a visual master at conveying that modern loss of faith.

I'm hit or miss with Antonioni and this one is a miss for me. I do love the hospital scene and the game between Mastroianni and Vitti. But that's about it. This one just doesn't add up like L'Avventura.

That last hug/embrace I've always found so moving.
